gen-gf-gabarito-gf-spectral: Expressive lettering leads here, cut open at the terminals so the shapes flow outward. Spectral, a classic serif, is the quieter half, with stems a touch heavier than its crossbars and tips that stop short of curling.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-spectral-sc: Gabarito draws like a pencil that never presses harder, open at the terminals. Spectral SC follows in a serif with sturdy hairlines and wide mouths on its round forms, so a long page feels bookish and steady.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-stix-two-text: Pencil-sketch swagger, all one line. STIX Two Text is the classic serif that grounds it, with thins only slightly lighter than thicks, and that editorial restraint is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-tai-heritage-pro: Gabarito has no brush-like swell at all, just cut-open terminals that let its counters flow outward. Tai Heritage Pro, a classic serif, reads dignified and editorial, its joins tapering modestly and a clear channel leading into each round letter.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-taviraj: Distinctive cut-out strokes, like a router bit of fixed width, give Gabarito its personality on top of the page. Taviraj answers with bookish stems barely heavier than its hairlines.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-trirong: Expressive and slightly quirky, Gabarito bends its strokes like a paperclip and opens every terminal wide. And Trirong, a classic serif, brings the bookish side, with softly varied strokes and gently flared curve ends that stay apart.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-trocchi: Dignified Trocchi, a serif, has horizontals slightly slimmer than its verticals and a c like a wide ring. Under Gabarito's constant pen pressure it makes a long stretch of text feel classic and unhurried.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-trykker: Trykker reads literary and refined, its modest contrast like lightly engraved brass lettering. And Gabarito, drawn as if with a fixed pen, gives that serif a distinctive, open-ended headline voice to sit under.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-uchen: Uchen is a classic serif whose lowercase curves welcome the eye inside, with a restrained swell like a barely pressed round brush. But Gabarito's monoline skeleton makes the heading feel unhurried and open, so a long page reads smoothly.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-vollkorn-sc: Gabarito brings a monoline skeleton and expressive, cut-open terminals that make headings stand out. And Vollkorn SC, a serif with a thickness shift you feel more than see, handles the literary, loosely tracked text below.
